slides.purpose: Frame the problem — why presentation quality matters and where PowerPoint falls short
slides.content_brief: Explain that presentations are a primary vehicle for persuasion and decision-making, yet most are constrained by a 30-year-old format. Use bullet points with a callout on the two worst PowerPoint pain points: bloated file sizes (8–15 MB average) and font substitution
slides.assumes: The audience has experienced frustration with PowerPoint at least once
slides.hands_off: PowerPoint's legacy architecture imposes real limits on presentation quality
